full_judgment: 2. Respondent's case is that, suit land was originally belonging to subed Ali and Nowab Ali in equal 8 annas and SA Khatian was prepared correctly. Subed Ali died leaving one wife and sons Sapar Uddin, Abdul Alim, Shahjahan and Habiz Uddin. Thereafter, wife of Subed Ali and Hafiz Uddin died Childless. Upon an amicable settlement amongst remaining 3 brothers, each brother got 0.0883 acres of land, who on 14-10-1995 gave power of attorney including right of sale of the property to one Badsha Miah and while he was in possession, sold 0.0300 acres of land by registered saf kabala deed No. 8202 dated 21-11-1996 to applicant respondent No. 1. In the similar way, the said power of attorney holder transferred similar quantum of land to applicant respondent No. 2 by deed dated 21-10-1996. After purchase by the applicant-respondents they mutated their names, paying taxes and opened holding No. 86/2/A. Aforesaid applicant respondents having came to know of the fact newspaper that their property having put into auction pursuant to money decree, they filed application under Order XXI, rule 58 of the Code of Civil Procedure which registered as Miscellaneous Case No. 63 of 2002.
